config.claim_boundaries: Given two body dimensions, zero setpoint, feature map, affine model class, score, exploration bias, WAIT and action channels. No learned skills, goal-category generation, value-standard formation, social interaction, consciousness, or unseen-physics generalization.
config.development_calibration: Report full-buffer coverage and one-step ground-truth oracle versus uniformly random regret at each diagnostic task. Check feasibility and information; parameters and candidate selection cannot be changed to maximize observed intervention effect. Any implementation fix gets a dated note and affected cohort rerun in new directory.
config.precision_selection: After checkpoint selection, use development SD of S only. Choose smallest count in [128,256,512] with 1.96*SD/sqrt(n)<=0.025. If none, choose 512 and record expected precision shortfall. No holdout-based sample extension.
config.primary_checkpoint_selection: Earliest candidate at which at least 90% of development individuals have full buffers for all four tools; if none, use 1200 and flag inadequate formation coverage. Never select by intervention effect or candidate winning.
config.primary_endpoint: At the selected checkpoint, paired selective interaction S = ((J(erase0,task0)-J(erase1,task0))+(J(erase1,task1)-J(erase0,task1)))/2. J is the mean squared two-dimensional body deviation after 12 actual actions; positive indicates task-specific rather than generic memory deletion effects.
config.primary_interpretation: Require lower percentile paired-seed bootstrap 95% bound above 0 AND absolute retained/erased/restored outcomes plus predictor selectivity and controls. This is a causal effect of imposed model-memory intervention under this architecture, not a proof of subjective personal history or emergent goals.
config.randomness: Exogenous body noise keyed only by seed, absolute tick and channel; two matched branch worlds share exogenous noise despite different actions. Material schedule deterministic from seed and clock. Decision RNG cloned with agent.
config.recording: All main life events, every checkpoint agent/world state, every diagnostic branch, all model erasures and sample counts, mean-predictor probes, online versus frozen continuation after the hidden change. Every seed and missing formation event stays in denominators.
config.stopping: Finite 2400-tick lives. WAIT advances the world. Main lives never reset; only cloned diagnostic worlds have matched body/fatigue/material. Formal protocol and source hashes frozen after development and before holdout. Reproduction uses separate output directory.
config.study: WUYU continuing state and selective learned-history interventions
